summary: Configure idle-residency diagnostics without enabling automatic suspension

replay.detail: No authoritative claims or persisted suspension records are written by the idle-residency policy configuration.

schema.detail: No SQLite schema or checkpoint transition.

rules.detail: No suspension producer or automatic resume is enabled. The policy is evaluated for diagnostics only.

compatibility.detail: Optional [reconcile] idle_suspend_after defaults to off and accepts durations of at least one minute. idle_resume_concurrency defaults to 2 and rejects zero. Older strict configuration readers reject these keys; remove them before downgrading.

downtime.detail: Both settings apply at daemon startup and on the existing two-minute daemon-policy reload loop without an additional restart.

manual.detail: No configuration change is required. A configured idle threshold affects diagnostics only in this release; it does not suspend seats. See the idle residency section of docs/site/reference/configuration.md.

recovery.detail: Missing, unreadable, malformed or invalid reloads retain the last valid policies. Setting idle_suspend_after to off, or removing the settings, restores the disabled threshold on the next valid reload.
